name: FONBET
verdict: Owned by businessman Alexander Udodov via the Pin-Up.ru company since April 2022. Nothing found.
note: Official bookmaker of FC Rostov; FONBET wordmark on the chest and sleeve of the 2026-27 home shirt. Also title partner of the KHL (deal khl-fonbet) and of the Russian Cup. Rating note: private bookmaker; licence held by OOO 'Fonkor' (Stavka.TV). Udodov is the ex-husband of PM Mishustin's sister (The Bell) — a personal connection, not a state stake. No court, regulator, UN-body or major-NGO human-rights finding against the company found (searched 3 Oct 2026).
